subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 16, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 16, 2026**

**PostgreSQL Development Activity**

In a recent blog post, PostgreSQL contributor Tomas Vondra has published an in-depth analysis of development activity in the PostgreSQL community. The post highlights the progress made in various areas, including performance improvements, new features, and bug fixes. This is a significant development for the PostgreSQL community, and we're excited to see the continued growth and innovation in this open-source database management system.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community is thriving, with many users actively contributing to the project on GitHub and GitLab. We're grateful for the dedication and passion of our community members, who help make AcreetionOS a better distribution for everyone.
* Our Discord server is also bustling with activity, with users discussing various topics related to AcreetionOS, Linux, and open-source software. If you're not already a member, consider joining us to connect with like-minded individuals and get involved in the community.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that AcreetionOS has a built-in feature to enable private browsing? To access this feature, go to Settings > Privacy > Private Browsing, and toggle the switch to enable it. This will help you browse the web without leaving any traces of your activity on your system.
